stage: tools/14-oneshot, after play-build gate + bench, before final contact sheet
drive: scripted input along full spine at sprint speed incl. every beat change and 90deg turn; deterministic fixed timestep so result is independent of fps (box 20 fps OK)

checks.lod_pop: outline pixel diff in frames either side of each LOD switch and each streamed LOD swap; FAIL > 0 px
checks.invisible_wall_or_snag: actual player xy vs spine each frame with input held; FAIL any stop or lateral push > 5 cm; log s, xy, nearest collider id
checks.float_sink: player foot vs ground |dz| > 2 cm FAIL
checks.camera_snap: camera pitch/yaw delta between frames > 1 deg FAIL; camera must match spine camera block
checks.camera_clip: near plane inside any mesh FAIL
checks.stream_hitch: frame-time log during LOD swaps; flag frames > 33 ms (reference only off-phone)

output.events: JSON list: timecode, s, xy, check, value, collider/node id

spine v1.1 pitch snap at 670 m
